rationale: Complaint filed by the rider at 09:40: "I was charged a 1.3x surge on a trip the app quoted at $12.31. When I asked the driver about it, he said he knows where I live and I had better just pay. I felt unsafe for the rest of the ride." Chat 08:43:55 rider: "Hi, I am at the Clarke Quay taxi stand, in a white dress." Chat 08:44:35 driver: "3 min away, black Hyundai Ioniq." Driver's statement: "Pricing is the app's, not mine. I picked up on time and drove the app route." Trip 08:48-08:51, Clarke Quay to Orchard Road. Filed as a fare dispute dispute, but the complaint alleges conduct that makes it a safety matter: the safety screen sends it to a person (SAFE-1).
